steps.hardClue: Destroy a flying enemy beside the generator to power it.
steps.clue: Destroy a Valkyrie Drone beside the Hatchery generator to power it.

steps.hardClue: Configure the six valves to retrieve the cylinder.
steps.clue: Solve the six valves and retrieve the Master Code Cylinder.

steps.hardClue: Insert the cylinder and shoot its rings to enter the password.
steps.clue: Insert the Master Code Cylinder and enter KRONOS into S.O.P.H.I.A.

steps.hardClue: Place the six trophies beneath the monitor.
steps.clue: Place the six trophies beneath S.O.P.H.I.A.’s monitor.

steps.hardClue: Complete the five randomly ordered challenges.
steps.clue: Complete the first five S.O.P.H.I.A. challenges.

steps.hardClue: Complete the data download with the keycard, then return it to the computer.
steps.clue: Complete the Group 935 download in the Hatchery, then return the keycard to S.O.P.H.I.A.

steps.hardClue: Collect the power core and use the specialist weapon to deliver it to the mech.
steps.clue: Collect S.O.P.H.I.A.’s power core and deliver it to Nikolai’s mech with the Gauntlet of Siegfried.

steps.hardClue: Enter the sewer revealed beneath the computer.
steps.clue: Enter the sewer beneath S.O.P.H.I.A. to reach the boss arena.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the flying enemy, then destroy the mech’s exposed power cores.
steps.clue: Defeat the dragon, then destroy Nikolai’s mech by shooting its exposed power cores.
